name: Francisco Assis - § 20 - Am 35
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 20. Expresses deep concern over the persistent global crisis of accountability and highlights the ongoing struggle to end impunity for violations of fundamental international human rights and humanitarian law in conflicts worldwide; reaffirms the essential neutrality and vital role of humanitarian aid in all conflict and crisis situations; highlights the grave repercussions of undermining and attacking multilateral organisations, including the UN, which risks fostering a culture of impunity and weakening both trust in and the effectiveness of the UN system; calls for the EU to defend the international legal framework and to implement robust measures to ensure adherence to these laws; is deeply concerned by the fact that the work of multilateral human rights institutions and the multilateral rules-based order faces unprecedented threats and attacks; strongly deplores the decision made by some countries, such as the United States, to withdraw from the UN Human Rights Council and their announcements that they would not participate in the Universal Periodic Review; condemns the constant attempts to undermine and discredit the UN, its Secretary-General, its Special Rapporteurs, and its agencies, including those delivering humanitarian aid, as well as the attacks on peacekeeping missions; denounces the US decision to revoke or deny visas to the Palestinian authorities in the framework of the 80th Session of the UN General Assembly and reminds the US that it is bound by the 1947 Headquarters Agreement, which regulates its responsibilities as host to the UN Assembly, to allow access to UN members and officials;
